  | tips                     = 
* This item is a tribute to Dave Arneson who narrated the [[Ruins of Threnal]] storyline. Blackmoor was his personal campaign setting, which he originally created for a series of fantasy wargames; the setting was later used as a development environment for the earliest editions of the game.
* You may decide to wear a different cloak throughout a quest, then don this one just before receiving XP at the end of a quest. (Many players do that with [[Voice of the Master]].) When a party is about to fight the final boss or open the last chest, you will often hear a player say "Voices!" as a reminder to the group. In party chat, someone might type "VOM", or just "V", to notify you.
* This is part of the {{DM's Vision}} item set, along with the [[Voice of the Master]] from [[Delera's Tomb]] ([[Item:Epic Voice of the Master|its epic version]] will also work.)
* This can also be used in [[Epic Crafting]] to make [[The Master's Gift]].
